philosophy: the crash zone is a GUIDELINE, not a rule: it raises candidates, it does not fire trades. The context layers modulate every candidate (the asset's own measured record - negative cells flagged, never excluded - the SMH region, the AVFI v4 read), and the judgment log is where the human decides, on the record, before the outcome. The SMH clock arms but never authorizes (direction refused by the central theorem); AVFI v4 colors but never authorizes (no out-of-fold hazard gain); exposure from measured distributions - one entry per episode, 4-week hold, stop from the exposure layer, not the clock
